class.name: DisCommentPdu
class.brief_description: Comment PDU (type 22): free text and other data for loggers and operators.
class.description: A Comment PDU carries datum records meant to be logged or shown to people, typically text added with [method DisDatumPdu.add_text]. Unlike [DisSetDataPdu] and [DisDataPdu] it has no request ID and no padding field, so [member DisSimulationManagementPdu.request_id] is not used.

method.name: decode
method.description: Parses [param bytes] as a Comment PDU and returns it. Returns [code]null[/code] and sets [method DisPdu.get_last_error] if [param bytes] is not a valid Comment PDU (header shorter than 12 bytes, wrong PDU type, protocol version outside 1-7, length field larger than [code]bytes.size()[/code], fewer than 32 bytes, or datum counts and datum records that do not fit in the length). A length field of 0 is replaced by the datagram size. Bytes after the last datum, up to the length field, are kept in [member DisPduBase.trailing_bytes].
